name: hcapp_setChatPin
description: Pins or unpins ONE chat for the calling hasher (E9.F1.S8) — a run, a kennel, a global room or a direct message; one SP because the pin icon is one control. Exactly one of @eventId / @kennelId / @roomType / @threadId names the chat. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 108, @param NULL). Permission gate: the hasher may only pin their OWN chats — @userId comes from the token, never a parameter. A room additionally passes HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom (so a pin cannot probe which rooms exist); a DM requires the caller's own HasherFriendMap row for the thread (never created here). Run and kennel chats need no further gate: a pin is a private preference. Storage differs by kind, deliberately: run → HasherEventMap.Pinned 0/1; kennel → HasherKennelMap.Pinned 0/1 (NULL = default, home kennel); DM → HasherFriendMap.Pinned on the caller's row; room → a bit in HC.Hasher.UnpinnedMismanagementRooms / UnpinnedAppAccessRooms, where a SET bit means 'turned off' (the mirrors store deviations), so pinning CLEARS the catalog's GrantMask bit and unpinning SETS it. MISSING HasherEventMap / HasherKennelMap rows ARE CREATED (James, 2026-09-14) in the neutral shape — only the keys and Pinned supplied, AttendenceState 0 / RsvpState 0 / IsHare 0 — which history and run counts ignore (both filter AttendenceState >= 20). Write SP: returns the standard success envelope. Since 2026-10-13 a kennel pin that has to create the HasherKennelMap row creates it with Following = 0 and MemberSince NULL (as hcapp_sendKennelMessage), under UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK. Since 2026-10-16 a kennel's Mismanagement chat (@kennelThread 1) pins on its own, independently of the general chat.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret; @param NULL). Default NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: A run's chat. Exactly one of eventId/kennelId/roomType/threadId must be non-NULL.

parameters.name: roomType
parameters.description: A global room (HC6.ChatRoomCatalog().RoomType). Gated by HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom. Mapped to a Hasher.Unpinned*Rooms bit via the catalog's GrantColumn ('mm' → UnpinnedMismanagementRooms; 'flags', 'platform', 'beta' → UnpinnedAppAccessRooms) and GrantMask.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: A direct-message thread (2026-10-01). The caller must already hold a HasherFriendMap row for it.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: 1 pin, 0 unpin. Required: NULL or any other value is refused. Also maps to HasherKennelMap.Pinned and HasherFriendMap.Pinned, and (inverted) to the Hasher.Unpinned*Rooms bit.

parameters.name: kennelThread
parameters.description: With @kennelId (E9.F1.S33): 0 (default) the kennel's general chat, pinned on HasherKennelMap.Pinned; 1 its private Mismanagement chat, pinned on the caller's EventMessageBadgeCounts row for (KennelId, MessageType 100), created if absent. 1 for a caller not in HC6.UserInKennelMismanagement, or an unknown value: Success 0 (logged).

rowsets.description: Auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail is returned alone and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Every other outcome. Success = 1 after the commit. Success = 0 with a user-facing ErrorMessage (and an HC.ErrorLog row) when: not exactly one target or @pinned not in (0,1) — 'That chat could not be pinned.'; a DM the caller has no row for — 'That conversation could not be found.'; a room the caller may not enter — 'That chat room is for the hashers who hold its role.'; or an unhandled error (CATCH, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; a user-facing sentence, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH, otherwise.

sideEffects: Run: UPDATE HasherEventMap.Pinned, or INSERT a neutral HasherEventMap row (UserId, EventId, KennelId from HC.Event, Pinned) when none exists. The HEM activity trigger fires but HC6.nonApi_refreshEventActivity guards its UPDATE, so nothing re-syncs. A row exists-check without (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) — see code smells.

Kennel: UPDATE HasherKennelMap.Pinned (explicit 0/1, never cleared back to NULL), or INSERT a bare HasherKennelMap row (UserId, KennelId, Pinned) — Following takes the column default (1) here, unlike hcapp_sendKennelMessage which writes 0 explicitly.
DM: UPDATE HasherFriendMap.Pinned on the caller's own row for the thread only.

Room: UPDATE HC.Hasher.UnpinnedMismanagementRooms or UnpinnedAppAccessRooms — pin clears the GrantMask bit, unpin sets it. A GrantColumn outside ('mm','flags','platform','beta') writes nothing and still reports success.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on every refused path and in the CATCH.

codeSmells.issue: Unknown eventId pins nothing and reports success
codeSmells.detail: Line 126–128 INSERT ... SELECT FROM HC.Event WHERE e.id = @eventId inserts zero rows for an unknown event and the SP still returns Success 1. Same at line 173: a room whose catalog GrantColumn is not one of the four handled names updates no bit and returns Success 1. Neither is reachable from the app with synced ids, but the envelope lies when it happens.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
